day_shape: Iran expels Swedish diplomat within 48 hours, UN fact-finding mission calls 2022 crackdown crimes against humanity, Jerusalem Post reports Iran struck a US-contracted vessel near Hormuz, and Khamenei's office marks 200 nights of street presence.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and Gulf pressure
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Iran struck a US-contracted vessel near the Strait of Hormuz and that transits fell to three ships on Wednesday. Trump is scheduled to meet Gulf leaders next week on the Iran war and postwar strategy, with US Treasury convening global financial institutions on Iran sanctions.

threads.label: Saudi–Houthi escalation
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Saudi Arabia struck Yemen's Al-Barh bridge as fighting with the Houthis escalated, and Turkey's defence ministry condemned a Houthi drone attack on Saudi Arabia. Analysis pieces described Riyadh facing a potential two-front conflict and growing Red Sea shipping risks, while Defa Press carried a Sanaa academic claiming Yemen's rise as a regional power.

threads.label: Iran diplomatic and nuclear moves
threads.summary: Iran's Foreign Ministry gave a Swedish diplomat 48 hours to leave Tehran in response to Sweden's expulsion of an Iranian diplomat, while Araghchi reported successful China talks and spoke with Pakistan's army chief. Iran International reported growing hardliner calls for NPT withdrawal after the IAEA referred Iran to the Security Council.

threads.label: IDF Gaza, Lebanon and West Bank operations
threads.summary: The IDF announced killings of Hamas and PIJ operatives including October 7 Nukhba members Sharif Shadi Ibrahim Labad and Jihad Samih Mahmoud Ismail, and the arrest of a senior PIJ figure in Burqin. Chief of Staff Zamir said the IDF was determined to demilitarise south of the Litani and disarm Hezbollah, with troops dismantling tunnels under Ali al-Taher Ridge.

threads.label: Iranian espionage cases abroad
threads.summary: Petah Tikva resident Alexander Granovsky was sentenced to 13.5 years for carrying out paid tasks for an Iranian agent, described by prosecutors as the harshest sentence yet in such cases. Four individuals were convicted over an Iranian plot to assassinate an Israeli nuclear scientist and his family.

threads.label: Mahsa Amini anniversary and UN findings
threads.summary: A UN fact-finding mission said Iranian security forces committed crimes against humanity in the 2022 crackdown, citing mass killings, torture and arbitrary detention. Iran International and Jerusalem Post marked four years since Amini's death, and the Italian city of Imola dedicated a green space in her name.

threads.label: Khamenei office marks 200 nights
threads.summary: Khamenei's Telegram channel posted three messages marking 200 nights of 'field presence,' and Defa Press and IRIB carried statements from the Assembly of Experts leader, IRGC Ground Forces commander Karmi and Passive Defence chief Jalaali praising public steadfastness. Defa Press also reported the unveiling of a statue of assassinated IRGC aerospace commander Hajizadeh in Tehran.

events.title_en: Statue of Martyr General Hajizadeh unveiled. The ceremony to unveil the statue of Martyr General Amir Ali Hajizadeh took place in Abu Dharr Square with the presence of Tehran Mayor Alireza Zakani, Tehran City Council Chairman Mahdi Chamran, the family of this esteemed martyr, and a number of municipal, security and military officials.
